content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Presets stripe

Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195, effectively excluding vast regions from its payment processing service. Similarly, PayPal has its own restrictions that can severely limit access for creators in certain areas. Alternatives like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy might be available but often come with their own limitations, such as payment holds or withdrawal issues. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, allows you to set up your online store, process payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, and maintain full control over your products, ensuring you are not at the mercy of platform policies.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Payment processors like Stripe and PayPal often impose geographic restrictions that bar users from creating accounts or processing payments. In countries like Nigeria or Ghana, this exclusion means creators must look elsewhere for solutions. PayPal account suspensions can also freeze funds for up to 180 days without recourse, creating a significant risk for creators. Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a path around these barriers, enabling creators in restricted regions to build their own payment systems and sell their digital products without dependency on traditional processors.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal often charge significant transaction fees and may experience delays in payment processing, especially for international transactions. In contrast, solutions like NOWPayments integrate directly with your infrastructure, allowing for instant payment confirmations on-chain with a minimal fee of 0.5%. This not only speeds up your cash flow but also ensures that you keep more of your earnings. With sovereign commerce infrastructure, creators can select networks like BSC or Solana to benefit from transaction costs under $0.10, vastly improving profitability.
Sovereign infrastructure means you own your entire digital store.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most critical aspects of selling digital products is ownership. With platforms like Stripe or PayPal, you are essentially renting access to their services, which means you don't truly own your customer data or the transaction process. Sovereign commerce infrastructure flips this model on its head by providing full ownership to creators after deployment. You maintain control over your data, automate payment processing, and ensure instant delivery of your products. This level of sovereignty is invaluable, particularly when navigating restrictive financial landscapes.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture for your online store depends on your specific needs and technical capabilities. For quick deployment and ease of use, the Sovereign Starter Stack may be ideal. For more robust functionality including additional products and configured email settings, the Edge Commerce Stack is recommended. This stack, which can be deployed in just 48 hours, ensures that your store is fully operational and tested before handoff, allowing you to focus on what you do best—creating.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
No more payment holds or account restrictions with sovereign solutions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.

You can use sovereign commerce infrastructure to create your own online store. Tools like NOWPayments allow for cryptocurrency transactions, enabling you to sell directly without relying on restricted platforms.

Using PayPal in these countries can be problematic due to account restrictions and potential suspensions. It’s better to explore sovereign commerce options for uninterrupted service.
What fees should I expect when selling digital products?
Traditional platforms often charge high fees and may hold funds. With NOWPayments, the fee is only 0.5%, allowing for better profit margins while ensuring quick payment processing.
How does delivery work with sovereign commerce?
Sovereign commerce infrastructure automates product delivery using tools like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring customers receive their purchases instantly after payment confirmation.
